messages:
elaine: Kicking off a staged rollout for service/model-api v2.14.0 — starting canary at 5% in eu-west (change window 19:00-20:00 UTC). watching latency and 50x p50/p95. please ack.

deploy-bot: Started rollout v2.14.0 -> model-api (canary 5% eu-west). Dashboard: https://deploy.internal/r/abc123. CI build: #4521.

mike: ack. quick heads-up: seeing a small 502 bump on k8s-proxy in eu-west-1 ~+0.25% vs baseline (last 2m). digging.

sunil: +1. looking at envoy logs, I see some upstream resets. possible kv-cache thrash after model change. grabbing logs.

mike: logs snippet: ```
2026-03-20T19:02:12Z model-api[kvcache]: evicted=120MB dur=30s errors=12
2026-03-20T19:02:13Z proxy[envoy]: upstream reset 502 id=0x9f3a
```

elaine: hmm. not huge but trend is upwards. can we hold the rollout at 5% for 10m and see if it stabilizes? if error >0.5% for 5m we should pause.

ops-oncall: I'll set an alert: canary_euw_errors > 0.5% for 5m -> page ops. Holding escalation threshold.

mike: metric detail: p95 latency increased from 220ms -> 340ms for canary cohort. p50 steady. looks like tail latencies.

sunil: kv-cache eviction spike correlates with tail. could be new model changing token distribution -> larger KV usage.

tessa: flagging support: if we pause, we should pin traffic back to v2.13.9 for eu-west canary cohort and update note in the release thread. I can draft a short blurb for release notes.

elaine: let's prepare to pause. if errors/tails persist, we'll abort and pin back. mike/sunil, can you run a quick canary-only rollback feasibility check? if rollback path is clean we stop.

mike: rollback check: route config exists, traffic split revert script tested in prod-safe mode. no DB migration issues. should be a quick flip.

sunil: confirming no schema changes. kv-cache config is compatible with v2.13.9.

(5m passes)

mike: errors creeping to 0.55% over the last 5m, p95 still high. ops-oncall is on standby.

elaine: decision: PAUSE rollout and rollback canary cohort to v2.13.9 for eu-west. Will not touch other regions. Marking rollout status: aborted.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by elaine. Initiating rollback of canary cohort in eu-west. Target version: v2.13.9. Action ID: RBK-20260320-01.

sunil: starting rollback job now. ETA ~3m. I'll post logs and confirm when routing switches.

(rollback progress)

deploy-bot: Rollback in progress: 3/4 traffic shards reverted. 1 shard remaining.

mike: verifying metrics during rollback — error rate trending down.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Rollout status: aborted. Active version in eu-west: v2.13.9. CID: abc123-rollback.

ops-oncall: Confirmed canary errors returned to baseline (0.18%). no further paging.

tessa: updating release notes: added note "Canary aborted in eu-west due to kv-cache tail latency; pinning v2.13.9. Hotfix scheduled." Drafted blurb and PR for docs: https://docs.internal/pulls/78

elaine: thanks everyone. next steps: research root cause (token distribution -> kv cache pressure), add small perf test to CI with longer sequences, and schedule a hotfix window tomorrow 08:00 UTC for targeted fix + re-run canary. I'll own the postmortem. Please add any findings to the incident thread.

sunil: I'll collect heap/eviction metrics and a minimal repro.

mike: I'll run a perf comparison between v2.13.9 and v2.14.0 on a subset of prod traces.

elaine: closure — rollout aborted and pinned. We will not resume until hotfix validated. :white_check_mark:
